name: Insurance Analytics
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; pip install -r requirements.txt; until pg_isready -h db -p 5432 -U postgres; do echo "Waiting for db..."; sleep 2; done; psql "postgresql://postgres:postgres@db:5432/insurdb" -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS insurance;"; psql "postgresql://postgres:postgres@db:5432/insurdb" -f sql/ddl_create_tables.sql; mkdir -p data notebooks/outputs; python -m src.generate_synthetic --rows-members 2000 --rows-providers 300 --rows-claims 5000 --out-dir data/; python -m src.load --from-csv --members data/sample_members.csv --providers data/sample_providers.csv --claims data/sample_claims.csv'
